_readme: Language data of the retrieval engine; the code stays language-neutral. To add a language, add a block with these keys. Text is matched lower-cased and with `fold` applied, so write words in folded form. Regex fragments of all languages are joined with |. `months` has 12 slots, January first; leave a slot empty when the word is ambiguous (English `may`). `probes` are everyday questions a knowledge base is unlikely to answer: how close they get measures the noise floor of an embedding model on this base. Routing: `whole_base` always means the whole base; `whole_base_soft` and `period_questions` only when the question names no specific entity; `whole_base_weak` only together with an `aggregate_nouns` word. `relation_signals` need a named entity with stated relations; `link_words` need two. `relation_blockers` before a relation verb (not, might) keep it out of the graph. `relation_noise` are words of a relation question that ask for nothing by themselves. `contrast_markers` before a name mean the note is turning it down. `units` are matched whole, to tell 15 minutes from 15 hours.
